en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a corner of Oschatzer Straße in Döbeln. Multi-story masonry buildings with shops line the street; signs advertise a hairdresser (Friseur), cigars, restaurants, and local businesses. A horse-drawn wagon and a few pedestrians are visible, suggesting an early-20th‑century European town. The caption at the top reads the town and street name.
